messages:
maria: Heads-up — canary for release v2026.3 at eu-west1 hit an abnormal spike in token latency and a handful of 503s. p95 ~2.3s (target 0.6s). Not full outage but degrading UX. Rolling to 10% now. @kirin @ops_oncall @evan can we triage and decide hotfix vs rollback?

deploy-bot: Canary deployment v2026.3 -> 10% in eu-west1. Healthcheck: FAILED (error_rate > 0.5% over 2m). Automatically paused further rollout. Logs: ```gateway: upstream 503 x12
model-serving: kvcache-miss-rate spiked```

ops_oncall: Oncall looking. Initial guess: something in the tokenizer changes in 2026.3. If it's regression, safest is to rollback to v2026.2.9 ASAP. How big is the patch in 2026.3?

maria: 2026.3 includes tokenizer tweak + small inference runtime tweak (quantization path fix). Patch is small but touches low-level path. Rolling back means reverting the tokenizer change and re-deploying, which is ~15m. Hotfix (2026.3.1) would disable the new quant path and push within 20m, but needs expedited approval because it skips canary.

kirin: +1 to rollback if user-facing errors are happening. But if telemetry shows only latency/503s for long contexts, a targeted hotfix could be faster. Do we have a simple feature-flag to disable the quant path?

evan: We do. Canary paused so we can either pin traffic back to v2026.2.9 or promote a patched build to canary. For safety I'm leaning rollback to 2026.2.9 then schedule a controlled re-release with the quant change toggled.

maria: We need an approval to expedite a hotpatch (skip full canary) OR greenlight immediate rollback. @sara_pm can you make call? Product impacted metrics: search chat latency and API 95th. If rollback, postmortem and release note update required.

sara_pm: Product brief — user impact unacceptable for next few hours. Ops, if rollback is ~15m and fully reverts errors, do it now. If it's longer, consider hotpatch. I approve rollback to 2026.2.9. :ok_hand:

ops_oncall: Rolling back now. Actioning pin -> 2026.2.9 and draining canary instances. deploy-bot, please run rollback playbook.

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated: traffic pinned to v2026.2.9 in eu-west1. Steps: 1) pin route, 2) scale up 2026.2.9 pods x2, 3) drain v2026.3 canary. Expected completion ~12m. Audit: user=maria, approver=sara_pm, oncall=ops_oncall

maria: Thanks. I'll open a hotfix PR for 2026.3.1 that disables quant path and add regression test for long-context latency. Team, please add any post-rollback notes here so we can include in release notes and postmortem. :memo:
